result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled `codeanalyzer`, but I didn't run any tests and didn't add one for this change.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. The remainder branch now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`.

- **Dormant contributors:** unmatched contributors whose latest commit is older than 180 days are left out of the remainder.
- **Blank dates:** `Contributor.isActive()` already treats a blank latest-commit date as active, so those contributors are kept.
- **Configured teams:** their matching branch is unchanged, so they keep all members, active or not.
